episodes.title: İlk Buluşma
episodes.summary: Six months after their sudden breakup while planning their wedding, famed architect Deniz and influencer-editor Güneş cross paths — just as a mysterious message appears on their phones. A fan from Cappadocia has left them a house, but to claim it, they must continue the "Mr. Alpha" game. Güneş, eager to fund her sister's education, wants to end things with Boran and focus on the inheritance. Deniz, ready to leave his toxic relationship with Umay, struggles with old emotions reignited by Güneş's presence. As they navigate this unexpected journey, pretending to be a couple once more, both must confront the unresolved feelings that still linger between them.

episodes.title: Aşk Bir Oyun Parkı
episodes.summary: Though Güneş and Deniz check in for their flight to Cappadocia, they both know they can't take this journey together. Güneş, focused on her sister's future, heads there with Boran. Deniz readies for a London trip, but memories of Güneş flood his mind. A final meeting with Umay stirs old emotions, and Güneş's podcast — where she likens love to a playground — leaves Deniz torn between duty and heart.

episodes.title: Verdiğimiz Sözler
episodes.summary: To claim a house left to them, Güneş and Deniz must convince a lawyer in Cappadocia they're still lovers. Guided by the late owner's will and letters left along the way, they slip deeper into the roles they're playing — often forgetting it's just an act. As they rediscover pieces of their past, they inch toward an unexpected ending, unaware that Umay and Boran have followed them, ready to shatter the illusion.

episodes.title: Seni Özleyeceğim
episodes.summary: Cappadocia holds unexpected beginnings and surprising twists for Güneş and Deniz's relationship. Convincing the lawyer they are lovers, Güneş and Deniz begin to piece together the fragments of their past relationship through this love game, growing closer as they rediscover what they once lost. Just as they take a step toward rekindling their relationship, the couple is confronted by Boran and Umay's respective surprises. In an unexpected turn of events, Güneş and Deniz will find themselves standing at a threshold that could forever change their lives. The couple must decide whether to cross this threshold and succumb to what life has laid before them, or turn away and chase the love they once knew. The only thing they are both sure of is that they will miss Cappadocia very much.

episodes.title: Güven Sorunları
episodes.summary: Güneş and Deniz, on the plane to Istanbul with Boran and Umay, can't seem to shake each other from their thoughts. Meeting at a dinner to celebrate Özgen and Hakan's union, Güneş and Deniz unexpectedly find themselves chosen as wedding witnesses, just as they begin to believe their own chance at love is lost. Deniz and Güneş team up to search for Ege, who has gone missing, and find him in the park. Through the innocent words of the child, feelings they couldn't confess to each other come to light. However, this isn't the only surprise awaiting Güneş. While fate seems determined to bring them together, a life-altering development waits just around the corner. Moreover, this development ties directly to the trust issues that have repeatedly tested their relationship.

episodes.title: Vedaları Hiç Sevmem
episodes.summary: As Güneş juggles the fallout from the Mr. Alpha exposé and fights to save her career, Boran's hidden agenda starts to surface after a tense encounter with Umay. Believing Deniz is stuck with Umay out of guilt, Güneş rushes to end what reignited in Cappadocia. But after learning the truth about Deniz, she's forced to say goodbye. They part, lost and hurt. Güneş, unaware of Boran's motives, chooses to move forward with him.

episodes.title: Aşk Yeniden
episodes.summary: For Güneş and Deniz, who reunite at their friends' wedding, love reignites unexpectedly.

episodes.title: Hatırlatma
episodes.summary: When their photos from the wedding are used in the Mr. Alpha exposé, a bigger crisis erupts, threatening both Güneş and Deniz's careers. Deniz risks losing his clients, while Güneş fears losing the mystery that fuels her audience's fascination. Forced to face the fallout that once tore them apart, they must choose to confront it or say goodbye. As Güneş plans for America and Deniz for London, a box from their past resurfaces — echoing lost love.
